component.name: open-chat
component.summary: Headless agent workspace engine with a browser session panel

description.p: open-chat runs the agent loop itself: a Rust daemon that composes every prompt from fixed frames, binds language and surface skill packs to the task, patches files as surgical diffs instead of rewritten blobs, keeps hybrid SQLite memory across turns, and throttles its own CPU use so a build queue cannot lock up the machine. Clients are thin: web panel, Telegram, or the CLI.

Anti-slop rules are engine law, not prompt advice: swallowed errors, narrative comments and filler prose are detected and reported, and any check the machine cannot run is disclosed rather than passed silently.
First tagged release: governor, memory, compositor, patch engine, skill registry, web panel, Telegram bridge, OpenCode model gateway and the usage ledger.
